_comment: Policy for the core scripts (workflow_config.py, registry.py, handoff.py, dispatch_run.py); replace every FILL value. Repo ids: short names without spaces or ':', the same here, in components.json and in specflow.local.json. The spec repo (the one holding specflow.md) has "home": true. Component status, deps and blocked live only in components.json. This machine's paths go in specflow.local.json at the spec repo root: never committed, and every worktree of the spec repo needs its own. spec_work is the capability handoff.py verify checks by default; keep it. handoff.file is relative to the spec repo root; local_only prefixes apply in every repo, so use only paths no repo tracks. Optional blocks, formats in each script's docstring: transitions and evidence_kinds (registry.py), dispatch.implementer and dispatch.report (dispatch_run.py), handoff.task_notes, resources, roles, test_profiles.

handoff.file: [FILL: the handoff file, relative to the spec repo root]
